sections.title: New Features
items: Added Auto EXP Boost to Outdoor Demon Boss with configurable EXP buffs.
Added automatic EXP Mark, Seal, Star, and Dust synthesis with dependency handling.
Added Fresh Beer support for Auto EXP Boost.
Added automatic Timed Demon Boss hunting with scheduled boss detection and routing.
Added automatic EXP preparation before boss-map travel.
Added Auto Repair and Auto Heal during Village recovery.
Added automatic return from Timed Demon Bosses to the saved Normal Demon Boss route.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved Timed Demon Boss routing and map-transition handling for more reliable boss travel.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Timed Demon Boss routing issues that could prevent the automation from reaching or correctly interacting with the target boss.
